scope: Database public declarations, ordinary and advanced compile-only consumers and five negative inputs
Database public specification, coverage/source/type policies and D14-D17 revised contracts
Database consistency of getting-started.md and guides.md
Reused source identities and finite verification evidence; no repeat of native experiments

findings.title: JOIN right-side alias creation and HasMatch have no closed native call sequence

evidence.observation: JoinPredicate.Right requires expr_column(query, alias, column_id), but the only documented alias is returned after clause 7 accepts its already-built ON token. HasMatch promises a native explicit match marker without an opcode that creates/reads it.
The ordinary LEFT JOIN consumer builds on.Right(Enrollments.StudentId) before LeftJoin returns.

findings.impact: The specified native-token-only adapter cannot construct even the ordinary JOIN example without an undocumented token rule or managed query state.
findings.remediation: Define native alias reserve/commit/abort or an equally explicit safe two-phase sequence; define ON-scope visibility and failure retirement; bind HasMatch to an explicit native operation and update matrix/type policies.

resolution.observed_change: Clauses 18/7/19 define reserve, ON construction, commit and abort. Both commit and abort invalidate provisional-dependent public expression tokens; commit retains its native ON clone. Clause 20 defines the private derived-source match marker, preserving LEFT JOIN nullability even when ON expressions are captured.
resolution.recheck: Static semantics and current source readback; not runtime product execution

findings.title: Expert SQL and returning mutations cannot pass required projection, named parameters and timeout through the stated ABI

evidence.observation: sql_create takes template, db-wire parameters and kind only. QueryAsync/StreamAsync require Projection<T>, ScalarAsync requires a configured codec, SqlCommand carries an optional timeout, and named @parameters require name-to-ID binding. No argument carries these facts. Mutation record field 7 refers to a projection ID without a registration operation/ID assignment.
These public members already require the missing facts; the omission is not an unexposed future feature.

findings.impact: C# and Rust cannot agree on result conversion, parameter placeholder rewriting or operation deadlines from the documented inputs.
findings.remediation: Add exact source-bound projection registration/lifetime and complete SQL control records containing terminal/shape/parameter schema/deadline data; define returning shape linkage and configured codec binding before execution.

resolution.observed_change: projection_register interns exact source-bound shapes. Kind 20 carries command/result class, finite timeout, projection ID and kind 21 name/ID/codec schema. Raw commands and returning mutations register shape first; fluent timeout is clause 22.
resolution.recheck: Static semantics and current source readback; not runtime product execution

findings.title: CTE owners and mutable window/Over calls lack native creation and mutation paths

evidence.observation: query_import kind 3 expects an engine-private CTE owner, but no operation creates one for CommonTable.Create. Clause 11 creates a fully populated Window token; WindowDefinition.PartitionBy/OrderBy/RowsBetween and SqlExpression.Over have no defined token mutation or attachment operation.
The documented advanced consumers depend on these exact owner/state transitions.

findings.impact: Implementation would need to invent hidden operations or retain a parallel managed representation despite the immediate-native-builder contract.
findings.remediation: Specify a source-bound immutable CTE creation/clone/retention/release path and query-local window creation/mutation plus Over attachment, including freeze/copy semantics, rollback on failure and capability gates; synchronize policies and operation coverage.

resolution.observed_change: cte_create clones a selected native body into an immutable owner; import kind 3 and clause 10 attach it. Clause 11 creates/mutates native windows and clause 21 snapshots Over. Source-generation parameter IDs survive Clone, Combine, subquery and CTE imports; incompatible duplicate names reject and execution validates the final schema.
resolution.recheck: Static semantics and current source readback; not runtime product execution

findings.title: db-wire container layout is fixed but scalar payload bytes and flags are underspecified

evidence.observation: The 96-byte header, 16-byte descriptor and 24-byte cell are specified, but payload_kind/flags/semantic-profile values and scalar encoding rules are not assigned.
Logical codec IDs 1..17 are fixed, but date/time epoch and width, UTC instant signed units, Boolean width, floating-point bits and decimal representation are not a complete byte contract.

findings.impact: Independent generated C# and Rust codecs can produce incompatible bytes while both satisfy the prose. NULL and malformed-input checks also cannot be implemented consistently.
findings.remediation: Provide one normative byte table for all ordinary logical codecs and configured variants, exact NULL/nullable flag bits, payload/profile IDs, field-width/range/reserved-bit checks, canonical metadata/parameter schema rules and representative golden vectors assigned to B01/B07.

resolution.observed_change: All scalar payload widths, sign, epochs, finite values, decimal bytes, NULL flags, payload/profile kinds and identity hashes are fixed. Canonical JSON escaping and stable metadata-ID hashing are deterministic; metadata_register receives a complete kind-2 envelope containing raw JSON. The published sample IDs and DateOnly epoch limits were independently recomputed and matched.
resolution.recheck: Static semantics and current source readback; not runtime product execution

findings.title: BulkAtomicity.All does not define rollback after failure inside a caller-owned transaction

evidence.observation: All only says it participates in a caller transaction without committing. If batch 1 succeeds and the input enumerator/constructor fails before batch 2, no rule rolls back batch 1 or prevents the caller from committing that prefix.

findings.impact: The public All atomicity setting could permit a partial bulk write on SQLite or after a managed enumeration failure even though no provider error marks the outer transaction failed.
findings.remediation: Define an internal savepoint around All within a caller transaction and rollback/release it on every failure, or explicitly poison/close the outer transaction so commit cannot succeed until rollback; preserve primary exception, BulkProgress and independent cleanup/outcome state.

resolution.observed_change: All mode in a caller transaction owns an internal tracked savepoint, rolls back/releases it after every input/mapping/native/cancellation failure, and allows outer commit only after rollback is confirmed. Failure to establish cleanup marks the outer transaction Failed and prevents committing a partial prefix.
resolution.recheck: Static semantics and current source readback; not runtime product execution

findings.title: The model example and its claimed generated-equivalent concurrency descriptor differ

evidence.observation: The record property has no WeaveVersion attribute, while the handwritten descriptor sets IsConcurrencyToken=true and is described as the generated equivalent.

evidence.section: 2 Define a model and query typed columns
evidence.observation: The guide repeats the unannotated Version property and points to that equivalent handwritten mapping.
WeaveVersion is the specified opt-in marker for concurrency tokens.

findings.impact: The generator-driven normal path and the compiled handwritten path would produce different metadata for the same published model.
findings.remediation: Annotate Version consistently or change the intended mapping consistently; compile the updated consumer and refresh source-hash evidence.

resolution.observed_change: DatabaseExamples.Student.Version now has WeaveVersion. getting-started.md still needs the matching attribute; integrated consumer evidence must be refreshed after this source change.

findings.title: Coverage includes an unbound Find adapter operation and weak source-record linkage

evidence.observation: The row names Mutation.KeyQuery, while the normative mutation registry contains only actions 0..6 insert/returning/update/checked/delete/checked/upsert and no KeyQuery sequence.
These rows lack reference_source_ids, although new SqlSugar rows DB-089..DB-096 link their read source records.

findings.impact: Find cannot be traced to a defined implementation sequence; reviewers must infer most reference-source correspondence.
findings.remediation: Document the exact native query or mutation sequence for Find and make adapter names agree; add source IDs for the actually read reference families or explicitly link inherited native evidence. Do not treat downloaded-unread files as read evidence.

resolution.observed_change: DB-018 now defines Entity.Find as exact key-expression/query/cursor operations and checks a second row. All 96 rows carry read-source IDs or explicit limited inspection scope and inherited native evidence; no downloaded-unread record is promoted to read evidence.
resolution.recheck: Static semantics and current source readback; not runtime product execution
